title: Reasoning as Compression: Unifying Budget Forcing via the Conditional Information Bottleneck
abstract: arXiv:2603.08462v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves LLM accuracy on complex tasks but often increases token usage and inference cost. Existing ``Budget Forcing'' methods reduce cost via fine-tuning with heuristic length penalties, suppressing both essential reasoning and redundant filler. We recast efficient reasoning as a lossy compression problem under the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle, and identify a key theoretical gap when applying naive IB to transformers: attention violates the Markov property between prompt, reasoning trace, and response. To resolve this issue, we model CoT generation under the Conditional Information Bottleneck (CIB) principle, where the reasoning trace $Z$ acts as a computational bridge that contains only the information about the response $Y$ that is not directly accessible from the prompt $X$. translated_title: 推理即压缩：通过条件信息瓶颈统一预算强制方法
translated_abstract: 链式思维提示提升了大语言模型在复杂任务上的准确率，但往往会增加token使用量和推理成本。现有的“预算强制”方法通过带有启发式长度惩罚的微调来降低成本，但同时抑制了必要的推理过程和冗余的填充内容。我们将高效推理重新表述为信息瓶颈原理下的有损压缩问题，并指出了将朴素的信息瓶颈应用于Transformer时的一个关键理论缺口：注意力机制违反了提示、推理轨迹与响应之间的马尔可夫性质。为解决这一问题，我们在条件信息瓶颈原理下对链式思维生成进行建模，其中推理轨迹 $Z$ 充当计算桥梁，仅包含从提示 $X$ 无法直接获取的关于响应 $Y$ 的信息。由此得到一个通用的强化学习目标：在压缩补全内容的同时最大化任务奖励。
tldr: 该论文将高效推理重新建模为条件信息瓶颈下的有损压缩问题，解决了注意力机制违反马尔可夫性质的理论缺口，并由此导出一个通用的强化学习目标，在压缩推理链的同时最大化任务奖励，从而统一了预算强制方法。
en_tdlr: This paper recasts efficient reasoning as lossy compression under the Conditional Information Bottleneck, resolving the theoretical gap that attention violates the Markov property, and derives a general RL objective that maximizes task reward while compressing reasoning traces, thereby unifying budget forcing methods.
